doomstorm.description:
Beware the Titan's wrath.
  • ⛅ Extremely reduced sunlight levels
  • ⚡ Lightning strikes hurt their unlucky targets.
  • 👀 Vision radius is reduced.
  • 📌 Clouds of doom pass across the landscape, destroying crops and hurting everyone.

firepit_titan_ghost.description: You can hear chittering from beyond the threshold...

root_of_evil.description: Kill it! Kill it with fire! (or Harvest it!)

corrupt_squid.description: Very grumpy today, we're all doomed.

doomstone_offer.trade_details: A Doomstone Exchanger offers [str(i18n_data.reward_number)] [str(i18n_data.reward_item)]. If you gather [str(i18n_data.want_number)] [str(i18n_data.want_item)], the Doomstone Exchanger will return with your item in [str(i18n_data.num_days)] day.
doomstone_offer.waiting_title: Doomstone Exchanger will be back in [str(i18n_data.hour_counter)] [str(i18n_data.period)]!
doomstone_offer.waiting_text: A Doomstone Exchanger will be back in [str(i18n_data.hour_counter)] [str(i18n_data.period)] to give you [str(i18n_data.reward_number)] [str(i18n_data.reward_item)] if you have [str(i18n_data.want_number)] [str(i18n_data.want_item)] ready!
doomstone_offer.return_greetings_positive: I'm back! It looks like you've gathered the [str(i18n_data.want_number)] [str(i18n_data.want_item)] I asked for. Are you still interested in [str(i18n_data.reward_number)] [str(i18n_data.reward_item)] in exchange?
doomstone_offer.return_greetings_negative: I'm back, but it doesn't look like you've got the [str(i18n_data.want_number)] [str(i18n_data.want_item)] I asked for. Oh well, maybe next time.
